title: ‘Mag-andam Ta’: Cebu plans 72-hour disaster preparedness campaign

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial Government is planning a disaster preparedness campaign that would encourage households to keep essential supplies for at least three days during emergencies. The proposed initiative draws inspiration from similar 72-hour self-sufficiency programs in other countries, as Cebu prepares for possible disruptions caused by disasters and the looming El Niño. “We are coming up with a ‘Mag-andam Ta’ (Be Ready) campaign just like what Europe is doing,” Baricuatro said during a press conference on Tuesday, November 10.
